title: Debating Political Necessity: szükséges, elengedhetetlen, kell

sections.title: The Rhetoric of Political Reform
sections.content: Reform debates argue what *must* be done using predicative adjectives: *elengedhetetlen, hogy... + subjunctive* (it is indispensable that...), *halaszthatatlan feladat* (an urgent task that cannot be postponed).

items.spanish: Kossuth szerint elengedhetetlen volt, hogy a nemesség is adót fizessen.
items.english: According to Kossuth, it was indispensable that the nobility also pay tax.

items.spanish: A jobbágyfelszabadítás halaszthatatlan feladattá vált a nemzet számára.
items.english: The emancipation of serfs became an urgent task for the nation.
